name: Medium Centaur
body:
Some centaurs have the upper bodies of Small humanoids atop the lower halves of smaller hooved mammals, such as deer or sheep.

Base Traits
Ability Score Modifiers Your net ability score adjustments are +2 Str, +2 Wis. This alters size.
Size Medium. You use weapons as if you were size Small instead of Medium.
Alternate Species Traits
Speed Fast. You are particularly fleet of foot; your base speed is 50 feet. This trait replaces weapon familiarity.
Horned You have horns or antlers, which you can use to make a powerful charging attack. Choosing bludgeoning or piercing damage; your horns or antlers are a primary natural attack that deals 1d6 damage of the chosen type (1d4 if you are size Medium). If you charge, this attack deals 2d6 damage (2d4 if Medium) plus 1-1/2 times your Strength bonus. This trait replaces hooves and weapon familiarity.
Nimble You are lithe and agile. You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity instead of a +2 bonus to Strength. Your net ability score adjustments are +2 Str, +2 Wis (if you are Large) or +2 Dex, +2 Wis (if you are Medium). This trait alters ability scores.
Spell Resistance You gain spell resistance equal to 6 + your character level. This trait replaces natural armor.
Favored Class Bonuses
Barbarian Add +1 ft. to your base speed. In combat this option has no effect unless you have selected it five times (or another increment of five). This bonus stacks with the fast movement class feature and applies under the same conditions as that feature.
Cavalier Add +1 ft. to your base speed. In combat this option has no effect unless you have selected it five times (or another increment of five).
Druid Add a +1/2 bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks against creatures of the fey type.
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting an overrun or trip maneuver.
Hunter Add +1 hit point to your animal companion. If you replace your animal companion, the new companion gains these bonus hit points.
Oracle Add +1/6 to your effective oracle level for the purpose of determining the effects of one revelation.
Ranger Add +1 hit point to your animal companion. If you replace your animal companion, the new companion gains these bonus hit points.

Awesome Ancestries: 9 New Fantasy Species. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
